## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In total, DharmaNexus identifies 2,643 matching passages between the *Vicayahārasampāta* and 158 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Canonical reuse is heavily concentrated in the *Aṅguttara Nikāya*—notably the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10), *Tikanipāta* (AN 3), *Pañcakanipāta* (AN 5), *Chakkanipāta* (AN 6), and *Catukkanipāta* (AN 4)—as well as the *Sāmaññaphala Sutta* (DN 2), the *Mahāsīhanāda Sutta* (MN 12), and the *Ñāṇakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.1) [DharmaNexus]. The text is also extensively reused and commented upon in the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Nettivibhāvinī*, and the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Machine alignments with non-Pali corpora match sections of the text with Sanskrit works such as the *Aṣṭādaśasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā*, *Daśabhūmikasūtra*, and Candrakīrti's *Madhyamakāvatāra*, as well as Tibetan translations of the *Vinayavastu* and *Akṣayamatinirdeśasūtra* [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
